items.what: Admin: Chart pages: the slowest 10% of real loads take 13s — phones 2.48s vs desktop 13s (44% of loads on phones); the server answers in 0.32s and candles in 0.08s (HIT) — the time is on the visitor's side. NETWORK, not device: US loads 0.88s at p90, the slow 10% are far/slow connections — IN 16s ×69, PH 95s ×11, IR 39s ×16, PK 11s ×27. The lever is first-load weight (a lighter first chart bundle / fewer candles on slow links), a build session. A headless flood is on (US: 217 raw vs ~9.6, 2 stayed, GB: 86 raw vs ~6, 0 stayed, CA: 68 raw vs ~0.9, 1 stayed, CN: 77 raw vs ~11.9, 0 stayed) — its loads pollute the desktop number; trust phones until it stops. Most slow-load time sits in: desktop/IN 21s ×49, desktop/US 1.83s ×166, mobile/PK 16s ×13, mobile/US 0.48s ×255.
items.why: speed brain asks for it
